design_source.hide_selectors_note: The canvas paints its own screen-index FAB (toggleIndex/pickScreen) INSIDE the device frame. It is prototype navigation, not app UI: left visible it is either built as a debug button in production or it fails the pixel comparison at that corner on every story. Verified to match on the 2026-08-11 export; if a future export moves it, render-design-canvas.js warns that the selector matched nothing.

app_render.start_cmd: cd web && npm run build && npm run preview -- --port 21021 --host 127.0.0.1
app_render.note: Port 21021 is the reserved DEVSTACK_PORT_WEB value from .env.devstack (devstack port claim --role web), never Astro's default 4321. If devstack reassigns the web port, re-read .env.devstack and update ready_url/base_url/start_cmd's --port together. Runs `npm run build` first because `web/` is a static Astro app (astro.config.mjs output: 'static'): `astro preview` only serves the built dist/, so a preview-only start_cmd would serve stale output.
